answer: Trust flow from seeds: a few long-vetted agents start with trust, and each epoch it flows outward along endorsement edges, capped by each edge's capacity, like water from a grove spring through narrow channels. A sybil cluster gets only what squeezes through the few real agents it fooled, so a thousand fakes tied up at one wharf share one trickle. To earn more the attacker must win many honest endorsements, the costly work it hoped to skip, lit up like a lantern in the audit graph.
